main_text.p: legatos ipforum, in Perham tendentes, capitc trucidavere, & Parice m, poft bieniüm obfidio- nem ad deditionem coegerat. Tertio, ob-Is- & cincta muro a Salamis Athenas, Pyrenaeus, Salamine vastata, frustra sub murorum scelere, Athenienses, Istos, Ads Phormione. Ierato prælio, Cenmilos s. vicere, & Periclem pestilentia amis. Lesbus ... defecit: classi es ut & ad Acarnanas, si sit ess, Mityle... se, & Platæenses murum tempestate ... scendere. Mitylenæi subactis... muros ... Platæenses exp... omnes ... & urbs ... Corcyræi seditiosi à Nicoltrato Athenien... conciliari, cum Spartanis pugnaverunt... sic... Argos... Cloponnensios, Argos ... ingenti clade adcere... Pyrrhum ab Athe- niensibus suasu Demosthenis captum & ... tum Spartani recuperare voluerunt... insidiis negata. Corinthii classe... mutata, & Corcyrenses exules capti... tidonte... Relīqui anni sequenti capti... Is... dei... se... tur, sed moxiterum revocatum... Ista, ut ... cesserunt.
main_text.head: TRAGOEDIA Odrys. Ilcaten. Sparfarorum ... Atheniensium
main_text.p: Lesbus... Is... Athenas ... Sycian... Bacchi celebrandi, Iofpiro exempit, & in Procons.

page.notes: Page is a heavily damaged scan: many marginal notes and lines are illegible; the transcription above is partial and approximate. Marginal notes on left and right are not legibly readable beyond fragments such as "Idem", "Thucyd.", "Diod." and Greek marginal references.
